name: nextcloud

check.cmd: snap info nextcloud | grep installed > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo installed || echo uninstall

install: hash snap > /dev/null 2>&1 || sudo apt update && sudo apt install snapd -y

description.zh: Nextcloud：可以自由部署的私人网盘。
description.en: Nextcloud is the most popular on-premises content collaboration platform you can download.
